units.source_text: > 你要守灵，又要办这办那，请多保重身体。

en.t: You have to keep vigil and take care of all sorts of things, so please look after your health.

units.source_text: 现在绫子来了，她会给我照拂一切的。

en.t: Now that Ayako has come, she will take care of everything for me.

units.source_text: 龙枝，你曾说过，这张梳妆台是一位法国姑娘——教会学校时代的朋友，作为她回国的纪念礼物赠送给你的。

en.t: Ryue, you once told me that this dressing table was given to you by a French girl, a friend from your mission school days, as a keepsake when she returned home.

units.source_text: 在留在娘家的东西中，这是你最珍惜的一件，恐怕那桌子抽屉里的白霜粉都发硬了。

en.t: Among the things you left at your parents' home, this was the one you treasured most, and the white face powder in its drawer has probably hardened by now.

units.source_text: 这些东西大概都原封不动地放在那里吧。

en.t: Those things are probably still there, untouched just as they were.

units.source_text: 远方的我，仿佛看到了映在镜中的你，你那身穿黑色礼服的倩影，实在美艳到了极点。

en.t: From far away, I feel as if I can see you reflected in the mirror; your graceful figure in black formal dress is truly beautiful beyond words.

units.source_text: 我希望你早点穿上华丽的结婚礼服。

en.t: I hope you will soon put on a splendid wedding dress.

units.source_text: 在我这里缝制也可以，不过向父亲央求，他一定也会很高兴的。

en.t: We could have it sewn here, but if you appeal to my father, I am sure he would be very pleased too.

units.source_text: 这虽然是利用对方悲痛的时机，可我估计父亲由于受到打击，是会同意我们结婚的。

en.t: Although this takes advantage of the moment of the other's grief, I think my father, shaken by the blow, will agree to our marriage.

units.source_text: 龙枝，把你看作救命恩人的弟弟，是什么态度呢？

en.t: Ryue, what is the attitude of the younger brother who regards you as his lifesaver?
